property_summary: For any fuzzed bytes4 value, C.supportsInterface returns true exactly for the ERC1155 id, the ERC1155MetadataURI id (0x0e89341c), and the ERC165 id; the mutant drops the metadata clause and returns false for the metadata interface id.
change_summary: Delete the IERC1155MetadataURI clause so calls with the metadata interface id return false instead of true.
